# Dr. Nihar Modi - Orthopaedic Surgeon

## About
Dr. Nihar Modi is a highly qualified Orthopaedic Surgeon practicing in Bandra / Khar / Santacruz, Mumbai. He specializes in Sports Medicine (Sports Orthopaedic Surgeon), Arthroscopy, and Arthroplasty (Joint Replacement). He is dedicated to providing advanced care for shoulder, elbow, and knee injuries.

## Specialties
- Sports Medicine & Sports Injuries
- Arthroscopic Surgeries (Keyhole Surgery)
- Arthroplasty (Joint Replacement)
- Trauma & Fracture Management
- Shoulder, Elbow, and Knee treatments

## Qualifications
- **Fellowships**: 
  - Clinical Fellowship in Shoulder, Elbow and Knee Sports Medicine, Arthroscopy and Arthroplasty (Orthoclinic, Australian Orthopaedic Association (AOA), Sydney, Australia)
  - Clinical Observership in Paediatric Sports Injuries and Musculoskeletal Trauma (Ascension Sacred Heart Hospital, Florida, USA)
  - Clinical Fellowship in Arthroscopy, Sports Medicine and Shoulder Arthroplasty (Mumbai, India)
- **MRCS**: Royal College of Surgeons, England
- **Diploma**: FIFA Diploma in Football Medicine
- **M.N.A.M.S**: National Academy of Medical Sciences, India
- **D.N.B. Orthopaedics**: Delhi National Board, India
- **M.S. Orthopaedics**: Maharashtra University of Health Sciences, Grant Medical College and Sir JJ Group of Hospitals, Mumbai, India
- **M.B.B.S.**: Topiwala National Medical College and BYL Nair Charitable Hospital, Mumbai, India

## Conditions Treated
- **Sports Injuries**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/sports-injuries](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/sports-injuries) - Accurate diagnosis, targeted treatments, and a comprehensive rehabilitation plan for sports-related injuries.
- **Shoulder Conditions**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/shoulder-conditions](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/shoulder-conditions) - Expert care to restore mobility and relieve pain from arthritis, rotator cuff tears, or frozen shoulder.
- **Elbow Conditions**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/elbow-conditions](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/elbow-conditions) - Range of treatments for issues like tennis elbow, golfer's elbow, fractures, and ligament injuries.
- **Knee Conditions**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/knee-conditions](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/knee-conditions) - Treatments for sudden sports injuries or gradual wear-and-tear leading to arthritis.
- **Joint Replacement Surgery**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/joint-replacement-surgery](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/joint-replacement-surgery) - Replacing damaged joint surfaces using state-of-the-art materials to eliminate pain and restore natural movement.
- **Arthroscopy (Keyhole Surgery)**: [https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/arthroscopy](https://drniharmodi.com/conditions/arthroscopy) - Minimally invasive surgical technique used to diagnose and treat joint problems for faster recovery.

## Procedures
- **Knee Surgery**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/knee-surgery](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/knee-surgery) - Advanced surgical treatments for knee pain, ligament injuries, and joint replacements to restore mobility.
- **Shoulder Surgery**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-surgery](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-surgery) - Expert care for rotator cuff tears, dislocations, and shoulder arthritis using keyhole and replacement options.
- **Elbow Surgery**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/elbow-surgery](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/elbow-surgery) - Specialised treatments for tennis elbow, fractures, and ligament injuries to ensure optimal recovery and function.
- **Arthroscopy Surgeon**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/arthroscopy-surgeon-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/arthroscopy-surgeon-mumbai) - Advanced arthroscopy (keyhole surgery). Minimally invasive treatment for knee, shoulder, and sports injuries with faster recovery.
- **Cartilage Restoration**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/cartilage-restoration-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/cartilage-restoration-mumbai) - Advanced cartilage restoration and preservation. Cutting-edge treatments to delay arthritis and preserve your native joints.
- **Fracture Fixation**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/fracture-fixation-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/fracture-fixation-mumbai) - Specialized surgical management of complex fractures and trauma. Advanced fixation techniques for rapid recovery and optimal bone healing.
- **Hand and Wrist Surgery**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/hand-and-wrist-surgery](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/hand-and-wrist-surgery) - Specialized hand and wrist surgery. Treats carpal tunnel, fractures, tendon injuries, and arthritis of the hand and wrist.
- **Joint Replacement**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/joint-replacement-surgery-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/joint-replacement-surgery-mumbai) - Experience pain-free movement with a top Joint Replacement Surgeon. Specializing in advanced knee and hip replacement surgeries.
- **Ligament Reconstruction**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/ligament-reconstruction-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/ligament-reconstruction-mumbai) - Expert ligament reconstruction. Advanced arthroscopic treatment for ACL, PCL, and sports-related ligament injuries to restore joint stability.
- **Shoulder Arthroscopy**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-arthroscopy](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-arthroscopy) - Expert shoulder arthroscopy. Minimally invasive treatment for rotator cuff tears, labral tears, and shoulder impingement.
- **Shoulder Dislocation Treatment**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-dislocation-treatment](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/shoulder-dislocation-treatment) - Comprehensive shoulder dislocation treatment. Expert care for recurrent dislocations and shoulder instability.
- **Sports Medicine**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/sports-medicine-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/sports-medicine-mumbai) - Leading Sports Orthopaedic Surgeon for expert treatment of ACL tears, meniscus injuries, and shoulder dislocations.
- **Tendon Repair**: [https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/tendon-repair-mumbai](https://drniharmodi.com/procedures/tendon-repair-mumbai) - Expert surgical repair of torn tendons. Specialized treatment for Achilles, Patellar, and Biceps tendon ruptures.
